sources.title: Motif 3: Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Motif 3 is a decoder-only autoregressive Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 314 billion total parameters and approximately 13.2 billion parameters activated for each token.

sources.title: [2608.09119] Motif 3: Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We introduce Motif 3, a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion activated per token. Each sparse MoE layer contains 384 routed experts, with eight selected per token. This fine-grained sparsity provides substantial expert capacity while limiting computation.
